component.name: Moonwalk
component.summary: See and control another computer from your Linux desktop

description.p: Moonwalk is a Linux remote-desktop streaming client built on Moonlight Qt. It follows GNOME and KDE Plasma, with a generic layout for other desktops. A compatible host runs on the computer you want to use.
This is a private alpha for invited testers on a trusted local network. Hardware, host version and permissions affect available features; broad hardware qualification is incomplete.

ul.li: Discover, pair with and connect to a host's Desktop target
Automatic stream settings with per-host Manual choices and recovery options
In-stream controls for sound, fullscreen, input release and disconnect
Hardware video decoding where the GPU and drivers support it
Clipboard and file-transfer extensions with compatible hosts

description.p: Honor Automatic display preparation and explicit connection options. Surface supported host fallback warnings while keeping the existing paired streaming path.
Keep working streams connected while optimizing: apply supported quality changes live and defer picture changes to the next connection, with an optional Apply Now action.
Detects retained Desktop sessions and offers verified host-control takeover before preparing a new main display.
Checks ownership on compatible hosts instead of silently opening another client's shared capture.
Connects to the main Desktop instead of automatically creating an additional monitor.
Ends HTTP connections explicitly between paired host requests.
Uses an advertised private desktop role when available, reconnects that role and releases its display without cancelling another client's game.
Preserves standard Desktop behavior on other hosts and sends advertised application UUIDs alongside numeric IDs.
Distinguishes Desktop launch targets from Vibepollo running-app shortcuts and recognizes host titles padded for sorting.
Improves copied diagnostic redaction and reminds users to review reports before sharing.
Includes source license notices and clarifies background cleanup and keyboard shortcut descriptions.
Keeps automatic tuning history across reconnects, verifies applied pictures, restores ineffective trials once, and bounds tuning disruption.
Retains encoder restart costs across resolutions and preserves desktop geometry when the host cannot negotiate desktop scale.
Requires authenticated paired-client state for target cleanup and preserves client authentication on new TLS connections.
Returns to the launcher immediately on disconnect while ending the remote session in the background.
Improves automatic tuning on hosts with limited telemetry, tries bitrate before small resolution changes, preserves requested frame rate, and restores the previous mode when a trial does not help.
Improves Desktop session cleanup and recovery, qualifies automatic performance learning, and preserves supported desktop scaling.
Follows the local HUD theme, corrects cursor coordinate scaling and HUD text metrics, and adds a host performance reset and negotiated video protection status.
